applicableAreas: Water line crossings with existing utilities in ROW
findings.comment: Water utility crossing shown on Sheet 20 crossing existing wastewater and gas lines, but no crossing detail identifies AE underground facility proximity or demonstrates 12-inch clearance. Verify that water line crossings do not impact AE underground conduit; if AE underground is present at these crossing locations, clearance dimensions must be labeled.

Underground electrical infrastructure shown on Sheet 21; water and wastewater utilities shown on Sheet 19. The plans do not clearly identify whether any non-AE utilities are proposed in joint trenches with AE underground conduit, or indicate if a written joint-trench agreement with Austin Energy is on file.

applicableAreas: Water utility tap in ROW crossing existing wastewater and gas lines
findings.comment: Sheet 20 profile shows water line (Wtr-Ln-A) crossing existing wastewater and gas lines, but the crossing method (trenchless vs. open-cut) is not identified on the plan or profile. Vertical separation distances are not labeled. Without crossing method designation and labeled clearance dimensions, the applicable separation standard cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Water utility tap crossing under Valley View Road
findings.comment: Sheet 20 profile shows water line crossing under Valley View Road (public roadway), but encasement specifications (material type, diameter, extent) are not provided on the crossing detail sheets. Confirm encasement piping specifications for utilities crossing under the roadway per UCM 2.9.1.D.

applicableAreas: Demolition activities adjacent to transmission easement and transmission structures
findings.comment: Demolition plan (Sheet 8) Site Demolition Notes do not address required transmission line safety clearances detailed in Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes. Missing: (1) pre-construction safety meeting requirement with Austin Energy 48 hours before work commencement, (2) barricade requirement 10 feet from transmission structures, (3) warning signs under overhead transmission facilities, and (4) prohibition on materials or spoils storage within transmission easement.

Construction plans do not demonstrate maintenance of a 25-foot-wide access corridor with minimum 16-foot vertical clearance along the transmission ROW. Transmission easement boundaries and access corridor requirements are not graphically delineated on the site plan or erosion control plan.

applicableAreas: SCM staging area on western side of site
findings.comment: Sheet 5 shows a 'Staging and Storage Area' on the western side of the site, but no vertical clearance dimensions or annotations are provided. The plan does not demonstrate the 14-foot minimum vertical clearance from existing and proposed vegetation and all other objects above the staging area.

applicableAreas: Staging and storage areas relative to transmission easement
findings.comment: Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes prohibit staging, spoils, and dumpsters within 25 feet of transmission structures. However, the transmission easement boundaries are not delineated on Sheet 5 (Erosion Control Plan) or Sheet 9 (Site Plan), making it impossible to verify that the shown staging area does not overlap transmission easement or violate 25-foot clearance from transmission structures.

applicableAreas: Entire site with transmission lines and distribution utilities
findings.comment: No electrical clearance zones or envelopes are graphically delineated on any plan sheets. Transmission line safety buffers (including the 25-foot no-dig zone and transmission easement boundaries referenced in Sheet 3 General Notes) are not shown. Distribution overhead conductor clearance envelopes are not graphically represented.

No horizontal dashed height limit lines are shown on the site plan or erosion control plan to delineate the overhead transmission conductor clearance envelope boundaries. Transmission structures and easement are referenced in Sheet 3 General Notes but are not graphically depicted with height limit annotations on site plan sheets.
